implemented.capture: Original native GPU readPixels and Canvas getImageData paths reserve RGBA8 storage before allocation. implemented.acknowledgement: Frame scratch begins before render/preparation and remains alive through original capture and the complete upload response. Success releases actual raw backing through native ArrayBuffer detachment and drops encoded-body ownership. Original failed producer/upload reasons, including null, survive secondary cleanup. A disposed allocator rejects late native completion.
implemented.integration: The actual export-page loop now uses these capture helpers and frame phases. Production memory scope remains disabled until Node and metadata admission is implemented; inactive scopes keep original native capture operators. Public native memory helpers are exposed through the renderer-core package boundary.
implemented.scope: Declared raw/captured body capacity remains distinct from native codec, network, driver and VM private RSS. Blob logical release cannot claim physical reclamation. Native proof uses original direct calls for independent full-body SHA256/size oracles on both Canvas/WebGL and complete actual localhost uploads. Capturing is covered under explicit managed scopes; the public production allocator remains disabled.
